items.t: Said election-administration mistakes happen almost every election, in response to the state's mail-in ballot error.
items.q: Maryland Lt. Gov. Aruna Miller rejects President Donald Trump's allegations of corruption tied to the state's mail-in ballot error and says election-administration mistakes happen "almost every election.

items.t: Said the Maryland State Board of Elections operates independently from the governor's administration.
items.q: Miller told Fox News Digital the Maryland State Board of Elections operates independently from the governor's administration and characterized ballot distribution errors as a recurring issue in election administration.

items.t: Said she feels strongly about providing disadvantaged community members access to resources such as job opportunities and transportation.
items.q: She shared with us that providing disadvantaged community members access to resources such as job opportunities and transportation is something she feels very strongly about.

record.t: Has served as co-chair of the Governor's Family Violence Council and chair of the Intergovernmental Economic Response Team since 2024.
record.q: Co-Chair, Governor's Family Violence Council, 2024- (member, 2023-). Chair, Intergovernmental Economic Response Team, 2024-.

record.t: Was elected Lieutenant Governor of Maryland and took office in 2023.
record.q: Aruna Miller was elected Lieutenant Governor of the state of Maryland, taking office in 2023.

record.t: Has served as chair of the Maryland Subcabinet for Public-Private Partnerships since 2023.
record.q: Chair, Maryland Subcabinet for Public-Private Partnerships, 2023-; Governor's Inter-Agency Heroin and Opioid Coordinating Council, 2023.

record.t: Has served as chair of the Maryland Behavioral Health and Public Safety Center of Excellence Advisory Group, the Maryland Overdose Response Advisory Council and other bodies since 2023.
record.q: Chair, Maryland Behavioral Health and Public Safety Center of Excellence Advisory Group, 2023-; Governor's Commission to Study Mental and Behavioral Health in Maryland, 2023-; Maryland Overdose Response Advisory Council, 2023-; State House Trust, 2023-.

record.t: Served as president of the Women Legislators of Maryland from 2016 to 2017.
record.q: President, Women Legislators of Maryland, 2016-17 (member, 2011-; executive board, 2012-19; treasurer, 2013-14; 1st vice-president, 2015; president-elect, 2015-16)

record.t: Served on the Appropriations Committee, including as vice-chair of two subcommittees and chair of the oversight committee on personnel.
record.q: Appropriations Committee, 2015-19 (vice-chair, transportation & the environment subcommittee, 2015-19; vice-chair, capital budget subcommittee, 2016-19, member, 2015-19; chair, oversight committee on personnel, 2015-19)

record.t: Served as a member of the Maryland House of Delegates from January 2011 to January 2019, after being appointed in December 2010.
record.q: Member of House of Delegates, January 12, 2011 to January 9, 2019 (appointed December 29, 2010).

record.t: Served on the Ways and Means Committee and its revenues, transportation and education subcommittees.
record.q: Member, Ways and Means Committee, 2011-15 (revenues subcommittee, 2011-15; transportation subcommittee, 2011-15; education subcommittee, 2013-15)

record.t: Served as a traffic engineer in Montgomery County's Department of Public Works and Transportation and Department of Permitting Services from 1990 to 1996.
record.q: Traffic Engineer, Dept. of Public Works and Transportation, Montgomery County, 1990-94; Dept. of Permitting Services, Montgomery County, 1994-96.

record.t: Serves as chair of the Governor's Work Zone Safety Work Group.
record.q: She serves as chair of the Governor’s Work Zone Safety Work Group, dedicated to making highway work zones safer and protecting the lives of workers, motorists, and law enforcement.
